## EMST role: Field resource technician (state variant, journey level; P1)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, confidence 0.55, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R02-field-resource-technician/state:2689`). *Authority position (editorial):* resource-manager.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols — journey L2
- Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys — journey L2
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — journey L2
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — journey L2
- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — journey L2
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — journey L2
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — journey L2
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — journey L2
- Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field — journey L2
- Describe, test and sample soils in the field — journey L2
- Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings — journey L2
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — journey L2
- Apply field biosecurity and decontamination protocols — journey L1
- Operate small boats and work safely on water in aquatic, coastal and marine field settings — journey L1
- Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems — journey L1
- Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks — journey L2
- Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices — journey L2
- Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence — journey L2
- Drive and operate field vehicles safely on unpaved roads and off road — journey L2
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — journey L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Establish vegetation monitoring plots to protocol and record species composition, cover and density within the program's measurement-quality objectives
- Identify plants on sample plots to the protocol's required taxonomic level, collecting labelled vouchers for any plant not identified with certainty
- Adapt the vegetation sampling layout when burned, flooded or grazed site conditions depart from protocol assumptions, recording the deviation for comparability
- Conduct point-count, transect or call-playback wildlife surveys to protocol, recording detections, distance bands and survey conditions
- Identify wildlife sign such as tracks, scat, nests and feeding remains to species or group, recording a confidence level for each record
- Deploy camera traps and acoustic recorders at survey stations to the protocol's height, orientation and settings, recording station metadata
- Measure temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and turbidity in place with field meters calibrated before use and checked afterward
- Collect grab water samples at locations and depths that represent the condition of interest, recording flow and site conditions at collection
- Collect benthic macroinvertebrate, algae or fish community samples from a stream reach following the program's habitat-allocation protocol
- Describe a soil profile's horizons, colour, texture, structure and coarse fragments in standard terminology on the program's description form
- Collect soil samples at specified depths and locations for laboratory analysis of texture, nutrients, carbon or contaminants
- Identify regional plants and animals to species with dichotomous keys and diagnostic features, collecting evidence for any record not identified with certainty

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* 1 not shown until the issuer is verified
